title: Oven-roasted char-grill-yang Winey Ukrainian Blackeye pea Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish featuring blackeye peas, char-grill-yang chicken, and a tangy Ukrainian-inspired sauce.

ingredients.name: 1 cup mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, zucchini)
1 cup char-grill-yang sauce (see below for recipe)

instructions: Soak the blackeye peas in water overnight, then drain and set aside.
Season the chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Char-grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and set aside.
Sauté the onion and garlic in the same skillet until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Transfer the skillet contents to the baking sheet with the chicken.
Pour the char-grill-yang sauce over the top and toss to coat.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbly and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the blackeye peas and sauce over the top.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
